en.hook: Odometry says I walked a spiral. One 'hey, I've been here' edge and I snap back into a square. Springs are magic.
en.mission: In `code/main.py` change `bias=0.02` to `0.04` and run it. Predict whether the closure still gets the rms error under 0.2 m, then check.

ko.mission: `code/main.py`에서 `bias=0.02`를 `0.04`로 바꿔 실행하세요. 폐쇄 뒤 rms 오차가 0.2 m 아래인지 예측한 다음 확인하세요.
